descriptor: Retailer whose retired pages get a museum plaque

voice.summary: The deadpan voice of a museum curator describing an extinct web page with total solemnity. It is affectionate about loss and always points visitors to something living.
dos: Write in plaque style, with date, medium and provenance

taglines: This page has left the building
Admire from a distance. It cannot return
boilerplate: Brightwick & Sons is a family retailer whose retired web pages are preserved as museum exhibits, with a gift shop and a guide to what remains.

logo.note: The ampersand-led name suits a monogram, like a brass plate on a gallery wall.
